claims.text: Atomic layer deposition can produce a thin, conformal copper coating on tungsten particles before spark-plasma sintering.
An ALD-applied copper coating will enhance wetting of tungsten by copper.
An ALD-applied copper coating will improve interfacial bonding between the tungsten and copper phases.
Spark-plasma-sintered or directly vapor-coated W–Cu samples can contain interfacial gaps, voids, and phase separation.
Keeping processing below copper's boiling point in a reducing atmosphere with controlled ramp rates will preserve the ALD coating until it promotes interfacial diffusion.
The nanoscale copper coating acts as an intermediary layer that promotes transient-liquid-phase bonding during sintering.
The coated intermediary layer can effectively eliminate interfacial voids.
The coated intermediary layer can ensure near-perfect contact between tungsten and copper.
Pre-wetting tungsten surfaces with the ALD copper layer reduces the energy barrier for sintering.
During spark-plasma sintering, the copper coating promotes diffusion bonding.
A transient copper-containing liquid phase fills microvoids during spark-plasma sintering.
ALD pretreatment will reduce phase separation relative to the vapor-coated, non-ALD baseline.
ALD-pretreated W–Cu composites will have a lower void fraction than spark-plasma-sintered composites made from vapor-coated tungsten powders without ALD pretreatment.
ALD-pretreated W–Cu composites will have more uniform interfacial bonding than the named non-ALD baseline.
ALD-pretreated W–Cu composites will have higher thermal conductivity than the named non-ALD baseline.
ALD-pretreated W–Cu composites will have greater mechanical durability than the named non-ALD baseline.
The proposed benefits will persist under high-heat-flux and irradiation conditions representative of fusion-reactor joints.
The magnitude of the property enhancement depends on ALD coating thickness, coating uniformity, and sintering parameters.
Long-term stability of the proposed W–Cu structure under irradiation has not been validated.
